g.text: Pricing: willingness to pay first, then the range
cost sets the floor; the substitute and the value set the ceiling
buyer, product, new category or a competitive one
value to the customer, or rival price + gap
unit cost; cost-plus is a sanity check only
cost or cheapest substitute to value or premium rival
tiers by user type or feature set
A/B price test; surveys are optimistic about price
the price sits inside the range, and you say why
